facts.fact: The National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS III) 2026-2030 carries costed Ministry of Health activities naming the system: national refresher training for county and facility HIS focal persons on DHIS2 reporting standards (US$105,000 over the plan) and equipping the HMIS Division and county teams with ICT infrastructure and software (US$77,504); the plan is undated beyond its publication, so that date is used.

NSDS III assigns the HMIS activities to the Ministry of Health, naming its HMIS Division, the 'MOH HMIS team', county HMIS officers and county M&E officers as implementers; the source of the money is not stated. Publication date used.
